entries.source: 恭喜你，幸运儿。被祂眷顾，是荣幸，也是开始。愿你在愚者的注视与庇佑下，旅途愉快。
entries.translation: Congratulations, lucky one. To receive His favor is both an honor and a beginning. May your journey be a pleasant one under The Fool's watchful gaze and protection.

entries.source: 使用后获得称号:<Highlight>锈蚀飞轮（7天）</>
entries.translation: Use to obtain the title: <Highlight>Rusted Flywheel (7 Days)</>

entries.source: 永不流动的黄昏凝结于发梢，哪怕此身沐浴落日，仍有唤醒黎明之志。
entries.translation: Dusk, forever stilled, congeals at the tips of the hair. Though this form bathes in the setting sun, it still bears the resolve to awaken the dawn.

entries.source: 伴随红月而来的疯狂呓语，小说家颂念了愚者的尊名，此时她尚且不知，这将是一场跨越家族和历史的旅行。
entries.translation: Amid the mad whispers that came with the crimson moon, the novelist recited the honorific name of The Fool. Little did she know then that this would become a journey spanning family and history.

entries.source: 脚步声在木质阶梯上更显清亮，连接不同楼层。
entries.translation: Footsteps ring crisp and clear upon the wooden staircase linking the different floors.

entries.source: 自由装修城堡，参与各种闲趣活动，享受疯狂世界中的片刻宁静。
entries.translation: Decorate the castle as you please, take part in all manner of leisurely activities, and savor a moment of peace in this mad world.

entries.source:
调动对知识的感知力，将自身钻研的格斗技巧拆解、融合，通过体验起手招式，深入武学精髓。当再度攻击时，将会留下一道源自知识的格斗残影。
吸收残影后，可使武力加3，直觉加1。
entries.translation:
Draw upon your perception of knowledge to break down and merge the combat techniques you have studied. Experience their opening moves to delve into the essence of martial arts. Your next attack leaves behind a combat afterimage born of knowledge.
Absorbing the afterimage grants +3 Might and +1 Intuition.

entries.source: 在目标位置召唤窥秘之眼链接目标，每0.5秒对目标造成*d伤害并使目标减速25%。链接最多持续4秒，目标远离窥秘之眼一定距离后链接会提前断开。
entries.translation: Summon an Eye of Mystery at the target location to link to the target, dealing *d damage every 0.5 seconds and slowing the target by 25%. The link lasts up to 4 seconds and breaks early if the target moves too far from the Eye of Mystery.
